data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Please navigate to the 'SSO & Branding' section in your Admin Console to ensure your custom logo and background assets are saved correctly. It is possible your browser has cached the old style, so I recommend clearing your browser cache. If the default branding still appears after re-saving, please let me know. [T-1291] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
